items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And I had a fellow named -- we used to call him Mr. Confrey on trombone, I can't think of his last name.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think it's probably the same.
And I had Lee Young on drums, Lester's brother. And I had a fellow named -- we used to call him Mr. Confrey on trombone, I can't think of his last name. And Tyree Glenn on the other trombone.
